summary: Tested the SYMSTRUO site (React) and FastAPI + PostgreSQL contact API. Backend: 8/8 pytest pass (root, POST->GET->row in Postgres, 6 cases that must return 422). Frontend: desktop nav and all sections render. /insights, /insights/:slug, /services/:slug and /faq routes work. No console errors. Mobile menu opens and links work. The contact form shows a toast on empty fields and a success toast after submit, then clears. On the first UI run the form posted to the hardcoded fallback https://symstruo-backend.onrender.com instead of the preview backend. Cause: frontend/.env was edited (20:27:40) after the frontend process started (20:25:54). After `supervisorctl restart frontend` the form posts to the preview /api/contact (200) and the row is saved in Postgres. Real SMTP: the admin notification was delivered. The auto-reply to the submitter is rejected with 554 for example.com addresses, which is expected for a reserved domain. 3 submissions were used: qa+1 (API), qa+2 (UI, went to the PRODUCTION onrender backend, so the prod DB/email got a test lead), qa+3 (UI, local).

critical.issue: No authentication. Anyone can read every lead's name, email and message (PII). Protect it with an admin token or remove it.

minor.issue: If the DB query returns 0 rows or fails, it falls back to the in-memory list. The response can then differ from what is in the DB and can mask DB failures.
A DB write failure is only logged as a warning and the response is still 200, so leads can be lost silently if Postgres is down (in-memory only, lost on restart).
Uses @app.on_event, which is deprecated in favour of lifespan. SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT and ADMIN_EMAIL have hardcoded defaults.

integration_issues.issue: App.js line 20 falls back to the hardcoded 'https://symstruo-backend.onrender.com' when REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is missing. With a stale env, preview submissions silently go to production. Fixed for now by restarting the frontend. Recommend removing the hardcoded fallback so missing config fails fast.

issues: In the screenshot ~1s after opening, the hero text ('Direction Before Execution', CTA buttons) shows through the drawer and overlaps the menu links, which hurts readability. Check that the drawer background is fully opaque and its z-index is above the hero.

action_items: Add auth to GET /api/contact or remove it (it exposes lead PII publicly)
Remove the hardcoded onrender fallback for the backend URL in App.js and rely on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL only
Restart the frontend after any frontend/.env change (this was the root cause of submissions going to prod)
Mobile drawer: make the background opaque so hero content doesn't show through
Old /app/backend/tests/test_contact.py is stale: it asserts 'AEDIFICA' in the root message, has a localhost default URL and sends real emails. Delete or update it
Consider returning an error, or retrying, when the Postgres write fails instead of a silent 200
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is 1147 lines. Split it into section components (Hero, Services, FAQ, Contact, pages).
server.py mixes email templates, ORM, routes and SMTP in one file. Move the email HTML builders into a separate module.
CORS: allow_credentials=True together with CORS_ORIGINS='*' reflects any origin. Tighten this for production.
Contact form has no client-side email format check apart from type=email, and the generic error toast hides 422 details.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all flows pass after frontend restart; mobile drawer readability issue)

seed_data_creation: Postgres contact_messages rows: qa+1@example.com (TEST_QA One) and qa+3@example.com (TEST_QA Three). qa+2@example.com went to the production onrender backend.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Each valid POST /api/contact sends real emails. Limit submissions. Admin email works; the auto-reply fails with 554 for example.com recipients (expected). Postgres check: su postgres -c "psql -d symstruo_db -tAc 'select * from contact_messages'". Restarted the frontend once to pick up .env.
rca of the issue: Symptom: the UI contact POST went to symstruo-backend.onrender.com. Cause: CRA reads .env only when the dev server starts. frontend/.env mtime was 20:27:40 and the frontend process started at 20:25:54, so REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL was undefined and the code used the hardcoded fallback. Fix: sudo supervisorctl restart frontend. After that, bundle.js contains the preview URL and the POST goes to the preview /api/contact (200).
